{{Quote|I try to avoid town when possible. I like the quiet of the outdoors.|Jareck Arned, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DASL" />}}
'''Jareck Arned''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Hermit/Legends|hermit]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You think just because I don't choose to live in a city, that I don't have a sense of style?|Jareck Arned, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:DJ">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Judgement|Corellia}}</ref>}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Jareck Arned lived a solitary life in his isolated [[valley home]] in the [[Nomad Mountains|Thaos Mountains]].<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of hikers disappeared in the mountains, near Jareck Arned's home. Arned was later interrogated by a spacer working for [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Talte]] of the [[Corellian Security Force]]. The hermit was compliant and gave permission to search the place.<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> However, the spacer discovered, to the great surprise of Jareck Arned, that some items in the house were tied to several kidnappings. Arned confessed that he bought most of these items from a traveling craftsman. He also explained that he found one of the art pieces in the mountains nearby just one day before. The spacer therefore went to investigate these statements.<ref name="SWG:DJ" /> The spacer eventually discovered that the hikers were captured by the criminals known as the [[cave-dwellers]].<ref name="SWG:DFtC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Disappearances: Finding the Culprits|Corellia}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Jareck Arned was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:DASL" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Jareck Arned was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 28 Notes for April 26, 2006|Publish 28]]," on [[April 26]], [[2006]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref>
